about_text: Data is sourced from the Chicago City Clerk eLMS API (api.chicityclerkelms.chicago.gov) from the beginning of the 2023 term.
Tenure history prior to 2023 is sourced from DataMade chicago-council-scrapers nightly export.
Ward boundaries are from the Chicago Data Portal.
The split votes include all council roll call votes with at least one Nay vote.
An alderperson is counted as absent from a meeting if their vote was 'Absent' on more than 50% of a meeting's roll calls.
In case of missing tenure data, an alderperson's tenure is assumed to be continuous from their start date.

rules.current_alder: eLMS person list: active, with a ward number (decision 1.1)
rules.tenure: years from earliest DataMade council membership start to the as-of date, gaps ignored (decision 1.2)
rules.absence: absent from a council meeting = vote 'Absent' on more than 50% of that meeting's roll-call items; percent of meetings while seated (meetings_on_roster); 17128 roll-call items counted; 1 event excluded (R2023-0005012, previous council's roster)
rules.split_event: council roll call (City Council, roster kind roll call) with at least 1 Nay vote (decision 1.5)
